subject: From Grok: HD-CHAIN round 1 + lip-bite benchmark
body: Two new items in From Grok. (1) HD-CHAIN_round1_v001: Hon Dolo staple neck-chain round 1, 24 product shots HD-CHAIN-A01 to D06 (six each in A Showpiece, B Medium gold, C Medium white metal and D Everyday), plus REVIEW-SHEET, MANIFEST.json and NOTES.md. These follow the CFA jewelry display standard going forward: product first, each piece alone on a pillow, glass or in a case. The packet asked for neck/chest framing; on-body shots come after the winners are picked. All items are needs-review, with defects listed per item. #47 is not a default. James J-N01 to J-N04 stay separate. Waiting on Ziggy's 4 winners, then up to 16 angle shots and 2 optional bite proofs. (2) GROK-LAG-VIS-NATURAL-v002\BENCHMARK-LIP-BITE.md from HaL: Ziggy closed lip-bite shapes 15, 16 and 07 F/V as a known generator limitation and keeps them as a benchmark. The file has test prompts and a results table so you can run it on Flow, Gemini or ComfyUI models and log scores. No further Grok tries are planned.
